description: Defines an abstract class 'ShortcutAdapter' for managing and displaying shortcut items in an Android application, including view binding, click handling, and shortcut data management.

classes.name: ShortcutAdapter
classes.description: An abstract adapter class for displaying shortcut information in a list or grid, with customizable layout and behavior.

methods.name: setShortcuts
methods.description: Sets the list of ShortcutInfo objects to display and refreshes the view.

methods.name: getShortcuts
methods.description: Returns the current list of ShortcutInfo objects.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses a view for a shortcut item and binds data to it.

methods.name: bindView
methods.description: Binds ShortcutInfo data to the provided view, setting labels, icons, and click listeners.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events on shortcut actions, triggering corresponding methods.
